primary.title: Bank holiday next week: SBI, HDFC, others closed for 4 days between 13 to 19 July; check here
primary.summary: Private and public banks in India will be closed for four days from July 13 to 19, 2026, due to various holidays. Customers should check the RBI's holiday calendar and can still access online banking services during this period.
